title.account_switch_link: Your code to add this account

otp.chatBody: {{title}}: {{code}} This code is valid for 5 minutes and do not share it with anyone.
otp.smsBody:
{{title}}: {{code}}
This code is valid for 5 minutes.

botLink.askContact: To receive your code here, confirm this number belongs to you by sharing your contact with the button below.
botLink.senderMismatch: That contact belongs to someone else, so it cannot confirm this account. Use the button below to share your own number.
botLink.phoneMismatch: This number is not the one the code was requested for. Start again on the site with the number you are signing in with.
botLink.expired: This link has expired. Request the code again on the site to get a new one.
botLink.takenByAnotherAccount: This messenger account is already linked to a different account.
botLink.noAccount: No account is registered with this number.
botLink.linked: Your number is confirmed. Your code is on its way.
botLink.linkedNoCode: Your number is confirmed. You can request your code now.
botLink.unknownCommand: Open the link from the site to connect this messenger to your account.

otp.emailBody:
{{title}}: {{code}}

This code is valid for 5 minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email.

payment.credited: ✅ Your payment was confirmed and {{amount}} was added to your wallet. Reference: {{reference}}
payment.reversed: ↩️ Your payment of {{amount}} was reversed by the gateway and was not added to your wallet. The bank is returning it to your card; if it has not arrived within 72 hours, contact support.
payment.creditedMany: ✅ {{count}} of your payments were confirmed and added to your wallet.
payment.reversedMany: ↩️ {{count}} of your payments were reversed by the gateway and were not added to your wallet. The bank is returning them to your card.

subscription.paymentDue: ⚠️ Your subscription renewal of {{amount}} could not be charged: your billing balance is {{balance}}. Top up before {{suspendsAt}} or your panel will be suspended.
subscription.suspended: ⛔ Your panel was suspended because the subscription renewal of {{amount}} was not paid. Nothing was deleted: top up your billing balance and it is charged and reactivated at once.
subscription.paymentDueMany: ⚠️ {{count}} subscription renewals could not be charged. Top up your billing balance or your panel will be suspended.
subscription.suspendedMany: ⛔ Your panel was suspended {{count}} times for unpaid renewals. Nothing was deleted: top up your billing balance and it is reactivated at once.

panel.accepted: ✅ Your panel {{panel}} passed its connection test and was accepted.
panel.refused: ❌ Your panel {{panel}} was refused: its connection test showed it cannot report what the platform needs. The details are on the systems page.
panel.acceptedMany: ✅ {{count}} of your panels passed their connection test and were accepted.
panel.refusedMany: ❌ {{count}} of your panels were refused by their connection test. The details are on the systems page.

purchase.delivered: ✅ Your purchase is ready to use. You will find it under My services.
purchase.refunded: ↩️ Your purchase could not be delivered, so it was cancelled and {{amount}} was returned to your wallet.
purchase.deliveredMany: ✅ {{count}} of your purchases are ready to use. You will find them under My services.
purchase.refundedMany: ↩️ {{count}} of your purchases could not be delivered, so they were cancelled and their full price was returned to your wallet.

retention.notConnected: 👋 Your service is ready but has not been used yet. To connect: open My services, copy the subscription link (or scan its QR code), add it to your VPN app — v2rayNG, Hiddify or Streisand — and connect.
retention.notConnectedMany: 👋 {{count}} of your services are ready but have not been used yet. Open My services, copy each subscription link (or scan its QR code), add it to your VPN app and connect.
retention.stillNotConnected: 🤔 Your service still has not been used, three days after it was ready. Copy the subscription link again from My services and import it into your VPN app. If it still does not connect, support will help you.
retention.stillNotConnectedMany: 🤔 {{count}} of your services still have not been used, three days after they were ready. Copy their links again from My services; if they still do not connect, support will help you.
retention.usageThreshold: 📊 You have used {{percent}}% of your service's volume; {{remaining}} is left. To keep it running without a break, renew it from My services.
retention.usageThresholdMany: 📊 {{count}} of your services are running low on volume. Check what is left in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.endsSoon: ⏳ Your service ends in {{days}} days. To keep it running without a break, renew it from My services.
retention.endsSoonMany: ⏳ {{count}} of your services end within a week. See when each one ends in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.endsWithinADayTitle: Your service ends within a day
retention.endsWithinADay: ⏰ Your service ends within a day. Renew it now from My services so it does not stop.
retention.endsWithinADayMany: ⏰ {{count}} of your services end within a day. Renew them now from My services so they do not stop.
retention.usageAndEndsSoon: 📊 You have used {{percent}}% of your service's volume ({{remaining}} left), and it ends in {{days}} days. To keep it running without a break, renew it from My services.
retention.usageAndEndsSoonMany: 📊 {{count}} of your services are running low on volume and ending soon. See each one in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.usageAndEndsSoonManyTitle: {{count}} services running low and ending soon
retention.usageAndEndsWithinADay: ⏰ You have used {{percent}}% of your service's volume ({{remaining}} left), and it ends within a day. Renew it now from My services so it does not stop.
retention.usageAndEndsWithinADayMany: ⏰ {{count}} of your services are running low on volume and end within a day. Renew them now from My services so they do not stop.
retention.usageAndEndsWithinADayManyTitle: {{count}} services running low and ending within a day
retention.ended: ⛔ Your service's time has run out and it has stopped. Renew it from My services to turn it back on — its link stays the same.
retention.endedMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services have run out of time and stopped. Renew them from My services to turn them back on — their links stay the same.
retention.volumeSpentTitle: Your service's volume is used up
retention.volumeSpent: ⛔ Your service's volume is used up and it has stopped. Renew it from My services to turn it back on — its link stays the same.
retention.volumeSpentMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services have used up their volume and stopped. Renew them from My services to turn them back on — their links stay the same.
retention.walletSpent: ⛔ Your service used up what your wallet could buy and has stopped. Top up your wallet and it turns back on by itself — its link stays the same.
retention.walletSpentMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services used up what your wallet could buy and have stopped. Top up your wallet and they turn back on by themselves.
